restaurants.name: Fishnets

pricePerPerson.label: $90–$140 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; typical shared dinner

restaurants.summary: Japanese-inspired neighbourhood restaurant with polished nigiri, seafood, tuna katsu and grill dishes.
restaurants.cons: A special-occasion budget; popular dinner sittings can book out.

restaurants.name: Trattoria Da Orazio

pricePerPerson.label: $60–$100 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; pasta, shared starters and dessert

restaurants.summary: Orazio D'Elia's lively all-regions Italian trattoria, with handmade pasta, seafood and charcoal-grilled dishes.
restaurants.cons: Prime dinner bookings are likely to be competitive.

restaurants.name: Stanley at Manly Wharf
restaurants.address: Manly Wharf, East Esplanade, Manly NSW 2095

pricePerPerson.label: $85–$140 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; shared seafood-focused dinner

restaurants.summary: Louis Tikaram's waterfront Cantonese restaurant with dim sum, seafood tanks and tableside Peking duck.
restaurants.cons: Premium seafood pricing and a ferry or drive from the CBD.

restaurants.name: Da Orazio Pasticceria

pricePerPerson.label: $15–$35 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Pastry, focaccia and coffee

restaurants.summary: Roman-style bakery known for maritozzi, focaccia sandwiches and polished Italian pastries.
restaurants.cons: Popular items can sell out and the Alexandria location is less convenient without a car.

restaurants.name: Bar Bruno

pricePerPerson.label: $55–$95 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; snacks and shared dinner

restaurants.summary: Rustic all-day Italian osteria from Odd Culture Group, with crudo, seafood, cotoletta and Italian wine.
restaurants.cons: Peak periods can feel busy and it is better for smaller groups.

restaurants.name: Ashe

pricePerPerson.label: $90–$150 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; shared dinner

restaurants.summary: Khanh Nguyen's high-profile Southeast Asian grill, using Vietnamese, Thai and Malaysian influences with Australian produce.
restaurants.cons: Premium pricing and several dishes have chilli or rich meat elements.

restaurants.name: Krung

pricePerPerson.label: $25–$45 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; main plus shared dish

restaurants.summary: Late-night Thai Town restaurant from the Abb Air team, known for regional pad Thai options and charcoal-grilled dishes.
restaurants.cons: Loud late-night energy; some dishes are properly spicy.

restaurants.name: Pasta Shop

pricePerPerson.label: $22–$35 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; pasta and optional starter

restaurants.summary: A casual 35-seat pasta restaurant with BYO and every main dish priced under $30.
restaurants.cons: Very small and walk-in focused, so waits are common at dinner.

restaurants.name: Taco + Vino

pricePerPerson.label: $40–$65 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; taco-focused dinner

restaurants.summary: Mexico City-style taqueria serving freshly made tortillas and premium beef gaonera tacos.
restaurants.cons: Focused menu and compact room; less suitable for a large group.

restaurants.name: Winnie's
restaurants.address: Lower Concourse, Sydney Opera House, Sydney NSW 2000

pricePerPerson.label: $45–$75 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; share plates or main meal

restaurants.summary: Large all-day waterfront venue under the Opera House, suited to seafood, snacks and sunset drinks.
restaurants.cons: Tourist-heavy at peak times and the best harbour tables are competitive.

restaurants.name: Chebbo's Burgers

pricePerPerson.label: $20–$35 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Burger, fries and drink

restaurants.summary: Viral smash-burger favourite known for crisp-edged beef patties, American cheese and house sauce.
restaurants.cons: Queues are common and it is a rich, burger-only meal.

restaurants.name: Mamak

pricePerPerson.label: $15–$30 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Roti and one main or shared dishes

restaurants.summary: A reliable, always-busy Malaysian favourite for hand-stretched roti, satay and curries.
restaurants.cons: Queues are normal and the room is fast-paced rather than relaxed.

restaurants.name: Malay Chinese Noodle Bar
restaurants.address: Shop CQT06, 33 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000

pricePerPerson.label: $10–$20 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; one main

restaurants.summary: A low-cost Chinatown option with a rotating Malaysian-Chinese menu and quick, casual service.
restaurants.cons: Basic food-court-style setting and limited atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Ho Jiak

pricePerPerson.label: $29–$60 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Express lunch or shared à la carte dinner

restaurants.summary: Lively Malaysian restaurant known for laksa, char koay teow and Penang-style street-food dishes.
restaurants.cons: Several signature dishes are spicy and queues are common.

restaurants.name: Gumshara Ramen
restaurants.address: Shop 25, Eating World, 25-29 Dixon Street, Haymarket NSW 2000

pricePerPerson.label: $20–$30 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Ramen and optional side

restaurants.summary: Cult-favourite ramen counter serving famously thick, rich tonkotsu broth.
restaurants.cons: The broth is very heavy and the food-court setting is basic.

restaurants.name: Chat Thai

pricePerPerson.label: $20–$35 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Main plus shared snack or dessert

restaurants.summary: Busy Thai favourite for noodles, curries, salads and desserts, with consistently strong Chinatown demand.
restaurants.cons: Queues are common and spice levels can be challenging.

restaurants.name: Tan Viet Noodle House

pricePerPerson.label: $20–$35 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Main and shared side

restaurants.summary: A Cabramatta destination best known for crisp-skinned chicken, noodle soups and generous Vietnamese comfort food.
restaurants.cons: A long trip from the CBD and queues at lunch are normal.

restaurants.name: Jimmy's Falafel

pricePerPerson.label: $20–$35 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Pita, bowl or shared casual meal

restaurants.summary: Fast, casual Middle Eastern food from the Merivale group, popular for falafel, chicken and loaded pitas.
restaurants.cons: Mostly counter-service and can be busy around lunch or weekends.

restaurants.name: Riva
restaurants.address: New South Head Road, Rose Bay NSW 2029

pricePerPerson.label: $75–$125 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; pasta, seafood and shared starters

restaurants.summary: A polished waterfront Italian restaurant with handmade pasta, raw seafood and Mediterranean drinks.
restaurants.cons: Premium waterfront pricing and less convenient from the CBD.

restaurants.name: Ananas

pricePerPerson.label: $55–$100 pp
pricePerPerson.basis: Food only; starter and main, or shared dinner

restaurants.summary: A revived French brasserie serving familiar classics, seafood and occasional tableside theatre.
restaurants.cons: The Rocks location can feel touristy and the wine list can raise the total quickly.
